messages:
alex: Planning a brief maintenance window for az-east GPU slab (rack az-east-03) on 2026-05-02 01:00->02:00 UTC. Purpose: NIC microcode + small thermal recalibrate. Will do single-node canary then 1-at-a-time if green. ops-oncall please ack.

tanya: acked. expected capacity dip?

alex: ~10% transient on burstable during handoff. No dedicated tenant impact (they're pinned elsewhere). We'll route overflow to az-east-spare for very short bursts.

rui: Canary node: gpu-az03-09. Flow: cordon -> drain -> apply-fw -> reboot -> healthchecks -> uncordon. Keep 10m observation after canary.

ops-oncall: I'm on. If reboot >7m or p95 >20% baseline, we halt. I'll watch metrics and alerts.

maintenance-bot: Maintenance window created: 2026-05-02T01:00:00Z -> 2026-05-02T02:00:00Z (ID: mw-1861234567).

tanya: KV pre-seed for /embeds and /recent-chat after uncordon recommended to avoid p99 spikes.

alex: Quick run snippet to add to runbook:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-az03-09
kubectl drain gpu-az03-09 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
apply-nic-microcode --node gpu-az03-09 --ver 1.4.7 --verify
reboot-node gpu-az03-09 --wait 300
run-health-checks --node gpu-az03-09 --checks net,gpu,driver-logs
kubectl uncordon gpu-az03-09
```

rui: After uncordon we'll run `cache-warm --pool az-east --prefix "/embeddings" --workers 3`. Also annotate node: `kubectl annotate node gpu-az03-09 redwood/nic=1.4.7`.

billing: FYI overflow routing may cost ~900 USD for the hour. Please confirm approval for contingency.

ops-oncall: Approved for contingency under $1k. I'll create temporary dashboard and alert runbook.

alex: I'll post status banner T-20m and ping customer-success T-10m. Link to runbook will go to https://runbooks.internal/redwood/az-east-1861234567. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
